# porch_domain_rule (Resource)

Enrolls an email domain into a tenant: users signing in through the given provider with an address in the domain join the tenant (`jit`) or may accept invitations (`invite_only`). A domain belongs to at most one tenant. Rules cannot be edited in place; every change replaces the rule (deleting a rule removes the memberships derived from it). Requires an installation `admin` token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Everyone signing in with a verified Google Workspace account of smith.example joins the tenant.
resource "porch_domain_rule" "smiths" {
  tenant        = porch_tenant.smiths.id
  domain        = "smith.example"
  provider_id   = porch_identity_provider.google.id
  evidence_kind = "workspace_hd"
  mode          = "jit"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain name (lowercase). Changing it forces a new resource.
- `evidence_kind` (String) `workspace_hd` (validated Google Workspace `hd` claim, `google` providers only) or `verified_email` (weaker). Changing it forces a new resource.
- `mode` (String) `jit` (join on first sign-in) or `invite_only`. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `provider_id` (String) ID of the `porch_identity_provider` the evidence must come from. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `tenant` (String) ID or slug of the tenant that owns this object. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Rule ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import porch_domain_rule.smiths <tenant>/<rule_id>
```
